blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Electric Co. (Meralco), the country’s biggest power distributor, is seeking bids for its 900-megawatt (MW) baseload supply needs, with delivery eyed to start by 2031. This came as the Pangilinan-led group secured from the Department of Energy a certificate of conformity on the terms of reference for the planned power supply agreements […]...
